name: 🧪 Skill Regression
description: Test cases per skill. When the office tries to correct one of its own skills, every case is run against the new text first — a correction that breaks a case is refused. The panel is where you write the cases and see the last runs.

commands.name: add
commands.desc: Add a test case to a skill

commands.name: run
commands.desc: Run a skill's cases against its current text

commands.name: list
commands.desc: Skills with cases, and the last results

commands.name: clear
commands.desc: Remove every case from a skill

library.for: every office that lets skills self-correct
